name: BITEZ - Delta-8 + Delta-9 + THCP 2000MG Gummies - Cotton Candy
description:
Sweeten your high with Double-Stacked Cotton Candy Bitez. These 2-count packs deliver a staggering 1,000mg per gummy, infused with a powerhouse blend of Delta-8, Delta-9, and THCP. Experience a dual-layer sugar rush that mimics the airy, melt-in-your-mouth flavor of fresh carnival cotton candy. Perfect for those who want elite potency with sweet perfection. Elevate your stash with this smooth, sugary classic.

Cotton Candy layers sweet Pink Vanilla with bold Blue Raspberry flavor, packing 2,000mg per bag and 1,000mg per gummy. Each gummy features a potent blend of THCP, Delta-9, and Delta-8 for a stacked BITEZ experience.
